what: A cover loader that plays once like a GIF. The first frame (a paper curtain covering the whole screen) stands for 2.68s, then the remaining frames are swapped at 40ms×5·120ms with no in-between values, lifting away like a flag. Nothing is left after the last frame, so the hero below is revealed. Meanwhile the greeting text on the curtain starts at .4s and slides in diagonally from 19·12px at the lower left over .6s with cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1), then fades out over .6s from 2.5s. When everything has lifted, is-done is set and fx:done is emitted without blocking interaction.

options.hold: Second at which the first section is shown, default 2.68
options.steps: Seconds the following sections stand at, comma separated, default 0.04,0.04,0.04,0.04,0.04,0.12 — as many as there are sections
options.in-delay: Second when text starts coming in, default .4
options.out: Seconds before the text starts to fade, default 2.5
options.dx: Initial horizontal offset as the text enters (px), default -19
options.dy: Initial vertical offset as text comes in (px), default 12
options.ease: Text curve, default cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1) — STUDIO .sd default transition
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Swappable section (stacked — the first section is the curtain that covers everything, the last is left empty)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text group on the curtain (optional) — slides in as a whole group on entry
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Disappearing text line (optional) — if absent, the whole group disappears
options.fx:done: Event fired from the element once fully cleared

from.where: index.html .nm-loader (original STUDIO fixed-version ::before one-shot GIF 1800×1232, seven frames — 2680ms·40ms×5·120ms, greeting text group on top .appear translate(-19px,12px) · fades in .6s, .4s later, text fades to transparent at 2.5s over .6s). The cover is seven of our own SVG flag sheets

note: The original GIF has no loop flag (NETSCAPE2.0), so it plays only once — here too it stops on the last (blank) frame. The heading and button are delayed separately so they turn on after 3 seconds (studio-appear --fx-delay: 3s)
